items.title: Why Bunge Global (BG) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of global agribusiness company Bunge Global (NYSE:BG) jumped 2.8% in the afternoon session after the company announced an agreement to sell two of its Brazilian sugarcane mills to COFCO International.
